_readme: Copy this file outside the repository, fill in the prices your provider actually charges you,
and pass it with --pricing-file or GENOME_ANNOTATION_PRICING_FILE.
Prices are per MILLION tokens in the stated currency.
The nulls below are deliberate: an unfilled file fails loudly at startup instead of
producing a confident cost of zero. Take the numbers from your provider's own price page
or invoice, and set effectiveDate to the day you copied them.
cachedInputPerMillion is optional. Set it when the provider discounts prompt-cache hits
(DeepSeek does); omit it and cached input is billed at the full input rate.

deepseek-v4-pro.note: Model DGR runs for query planning, literature learning, and report synthesis (MCP_THINKING_MODEL / MCP_TASK_MODEL).

deepseek-v4-flash.note: Model the orchestrating agent runs. Its usage arrives through the agent usage sidecar.
